es: Redactar la misma petición de cambio de horario para tres destinatarios (amigo, profesora y empresa) con el registro adecuado en cada caso.

teaching.en: Hi Tom, my dentist appointment is going to clash with our training on Friday, so can we swap days? I'm free on Saturday or Sunday.
teaching.es: Hola, Tom, mi cita con el dentista va a coincidir con nuestro entrenamiento del viernes, ¿podemos cambiar de día? Estoy libre el sábado o el domingo.
teaching.explanationEs: Amigo: informal, con contracciones, swap y clash with; I'm free en lugar de I am available.

Friday, so can we swap days? I'm free on Saturday or Sunday.
teaching.audioText: Hi Tom, my dentist appointment is going to clash with our training on Friday, so can we swap days? I'm free on Saturday or Sunday.

teaching.en: Dear Mrs Lee, I am writing to ask whether it would be possible to reschedule my appointment, as I have been asked to travel at short notice.
teaching.es: Estimada señora Lee, le escribo para preguntar si sería posible reprogramar mi cita, ya que me han pedido viajar con poco aviso.
teaching.explanationEs: Profesora: formal, sin contracciones; whether it would be possible to + verbo; at short notice = con poco aviso.
segments: Dear Mrs Lee, I am writing to ask whether it would be possible to
reschedule my appointment, as I have been asked to travel at short notice.

teaching.en: I am available on Monday and Tuesday afternoons; would either of those days be convenient for you, or would you prefer another time?
teaching.es: Estoy disponible el lunes y el martes por la tarde; ¿le vendría bien alguno de esos días o preferiría otra hora?
teaching.explanationEs: Available + on + día (sin the); would… be convenient for you? propone con cortesía.
segments: I am available on Monday and Tuesday afternoons; would either of those
days be convenient for you, or would you prefer another time?
teaching.audioText: I am available on Monday and Tuesday afternoons; would either of those days be convenient for you, or would you prefer another time?

teaching.en: Dear Sir or Madam, I would be grateful if you could let me know, at your earliest convenience, whether my appointment on Friday can be moved.
teaching.es: Estimados señores, les agradecería que me informaran, a la mayor brevedad posible, de si mi cita del viernes puede trasladarse.
teaching.explanationEs: Empresa desconocida: Dear Sir or Madam; at your earliest convenience es muy formal.
segments: Dear Sir or Madam, I would be grateful if you could let me
know, at your earliest convenience, whether my appointment on Friday can be moved.
teaching.audioText: Dear Sir or Madam, I would be grateful if you could let me know, at your earliest convenience, whether my appointment on Friday can be moved.

teaching.en: I apologise for any inconvenience and thank you in advance for your understanding. Yours faithfully, Ana Ruiz.
teaching.es: Pido disculpas por cualquier molestia y les agradezco de antemano su comprensión. Atentamente, Ana Ruiz.
teaching.explanationEs: Cierre formal: apologise for any inconvenience + Yours faithfully (tras Dear Sir or Madam).
segments: I apologise for any inconvenience and thank you in
advance for your understanding. Yours faithfully, Ana Ruiz.
teaching.audioText: I apologise for any inconvenience and thank you in advance for your understanding. Yours faithfully, Ana Ruiz.

teaching.en: With a close friend you can simply pencil in a new day and sign off with Cheers; Kind regards would sound oddly stiff in a chat.
teaching.es: Con un amigo cercano puedes anotar un nuevo día y despedirte con Cheers; Kind regards sonaría raro y rígido en un chat.
teaching.explanationEs: Pencil in = fijar provisionalmente; el cierre debe encajar con el registro del saludo.
segments: With a close friend you can simply pencil in a new day and

prompt.es: Elige el mensaje adecuado para proponerle el cambio a tu amigo Tom.

choices.text: Hi Tom, I am writing to ask whether Saturday would be convenient for you. Yours faithfully, Ana.
Dear Tom, I would be grateful if you could reschedule our training for Saturday. Kind regards, Ana.
Hi Tom, something has come up on Friday, so can we swap to Saturday? I'm free all day.

feedback.es: Un amigo admite Hi, contracciones y un cierre corto; las otras opciones mezclan fórmulas formales.

hint.es: Con un amigo: saludo con Hi, contracciones y cierre corto.

origin.text: Ana cannot train with her friend Tom on Friday, but she is available on Saturday. She wants to suggest a change in a short, relaxed message.

prompt.es: Completa: «Le agradecería que respondiera a la mayor brevedad posible.»

feedback.es: At your earliest convenience es la fórmula formal para pedir una respuesta cuanto antes.

hint.es: Sustantivo de la familia de convenient.

feedback.es: Cada frase cumple una función distinta: disponibilidad o excusa, en registro coloquial o formal.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige el consejo principal que da Leo a Mia.

choices.text: Think about who will read the message before choosing the words.
Keep each message short, because busy readers ignore long emails.
Write in a formal style for everyone, because formal is always safe.

feedback.es: Leo resume el consejo al final: primero identificar al lector y solo después elegir el registro.

origin.audio: Yesterday Mia had to move an eye test she had booked for Friday. She started with a single message, but her brother Leo, who works in a bank, told her that it would not do for everybody. To the optician's she should write Dear Sir or Madam and ask, very politely, whether another time would be possible. To her friend Sara, with whom she was going to the cinema, a quick Hi Sara, can we swap to Saturday? would be enough. Leo's advice was simple: decide who is going to read it, and only then choose your words.

Hi Tom, I can't make it on Friday, sorry. Could we change the training to Saturday? I'm free all day. Cheers!

feedback.es: Con un amigo, una petición breve con can we, contracciones y un cierre corto es lo natural.

origin.text: Tom es tu amigo. Te ha surgido algo el viernes y quieres cambiar el entrenamiento al sábado; estás libre todo el día.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje: ¿a quién se dirige la hablante y qué pide?

choices.text: To a teacher she knows well, apologising for missing a class.
To a company, asking politely for a new time and a call.
To a friend, suggesting that they swap the day in a relaxed way.

feedback.es: La fórmula formal, el equipo de reservas y la petición de llamada indican una organización desconocida.

origin.audio: Hello, this message is for the booking team. I am writing to ask whether it would be possible to move my appointment on Friday. I would be grateful if you could call me back at your earliest convenience. I am available on Monday and Tuesday afternoons. Thank you in advance, and I apologise for any inconvenience.

prompt.es: Escucha otra vez: ¿con qué propósito dice la hablante «thank you in advance»?

choices.text: To apologise in advance in case the company cannot help her.
To thank the company for a service it has already given her.
To politely express confidence that the request will be accepted.

feedback.es: Agradecer de antemano es una cortesía formal que da por buena la petición, sin haber recibido aún el favor.

prompt.es: ¿Qué actitud transmiten «I am afraid» y «Would that be convenient?»

choices.text: She is respectful: she suggests a time but does not order the teacher.
She is doubtful: she is not sure that she wants the appointment at all.
She is careless: she lets the teacher decide absolutely everything alone.

feedback.es: La disculpa previa y la pregunta final muestran respeto: propone una hora concreta pero deja elegir a la profesora.

origin.text: When a formal letter begins with Dear Sir or Madam, the usual closing is Yours ___, not Yours sincerely.
